params.body:
Follow-up to #12 and #13.

## What

- **Sticker on the community card:** the KUBO CyberSec card on /communities (and the nl and fr copies) shows the sudo ./learn keycap from the community's page, top right, slightly tilted like a sticker and straightening on hover. No motion with reduced motion. It reuses the 480 px webp already served for the community page, with explicit dimensions, so no new files.
- **Alt text left empty on purpose:** the image sits inside the card's link, whose text already names the community, and the community page carries the full description of the sticker. A full description here would only lengthen the link's name for screen readers.
- **Wording:** the card text and the community page's meta description broke off into "Its first event: a ...". They now run on in one sentence: "..., from first steps to advanced, starting with a Capture the Flag on 14 November 2026 at the IT Lab in Bakoteh." Same in nl ("te beginnen met") and fr ("en commençant par"). The sentence still holds after the date.

## Checks

- Tests: 25 pass. Build: clean. `npm run check:built`: no contact number in 80 text files.
- Looked at by screenshot on desktop and phone in en, nl and fr: the sticker loads, no horizontal overflow.
params.title: Communities: the KUBO CyberSec card carries the community's sticker
